ranking_rule.primary_objective: maximize sustainable realistic after-cost geometric daily growth below and above the 1% reference while satisfying survival and recoverability
ranking_rule.survival_constraint: a candidate with forced liquidation, irrecoverable account damage, or a prohibited elapsed-time liquidation cannot rank

first_place.selection_reason: At the normalized 24bp comparison cost, the 2023 Donchian all-breakout path remains the highest recorded current-contract-compatible account at 0.0700189% geometric growth per UTC calendar day. Official 2024H1 was then opened as an active sequential research interval: the unchanged unfiltered route fell to 0.0100516% daily and one frozen HGBT accept/flat filter reached 0.0387317%. Both official paths remain structurally far below 1% and winner-concentrated, so the family is retired rather than protected even though the historical 24bp path remains provisional rank one.
known_weaknesses: Binance USD-M completed bars are a proxy rather than exact Bybit execution.
Completed 60-minute bars do not reproduce tick-level stop-order triggering.
The normalized 24bp median trade is -50bp and only 20.2% of trades win.
The five largest winners provide 64.22% of positive PnL.
Removing the largest positive 10% of event keys changes the 24bp 2023 return to -26.95%.
Official 2024H1 unfiltered growth fell to 0.0100516% daily, only 1.005% of the 1% reference.
The HGBT-filtered official 2024H1 path reached 0.0387317% daily but changed from +7.3021% to -7.6610% after winner-removal rerouting.
The HGBT had negative MAE skill against a constant baseline in pre-2024 confirmation and 2024H1.
This first place is non-ML and its tested ML filter is retired; neither is a deployable final system.

reconciliation_notes: Opened 2024H1 as the first official sequential research interval for a strategy frozen through 2023-12-31; official evaluation is no longer described as unopened.
The unchanged Donchian baseline produced 0.0100516% daily growth at 24bp in 2024H1. A frozen HGBT accept/flat filter improved it to 0.0387317% but remained structurally far below 1%.
The HGBT path is inserted at provisional rank 3 under normalized 24bp conditions, above the CME gap path's 0.0334850% 24bp growth.
Winner-removal rerouting changed the HGBT path from +7.3021% to -7.6610%, and MAE skill was negative; the exact information unit is retired rather than tuned.
2024H1 is now seen sequential evidence and cannot be called fresh independent OOS for a modified strategy.
Active research remains on materially different stablecoin issuance and Uniswap inventory-transfer sources.
Rank does not imply economic-gate passage, deployment permission, research priority or protection.
